summary: 47-year-old male skier beginning a ski descent of the Skywalker Couloir on South Arapahoe Peak fell, sliding and tumbling ~1,000-2,000 ft down the snowfield to a rock ledge; two off-duty firefighters witnessed the fall, called 911 and gave first aid; RMRG rescuers flown near the scene by MedEvac packaged him in a full-body vacuum splint, and the Colorado Hoist Rescue Team hoisted him to Nederland Middle/Senior High School, from which AMR took him by ambulance to a hospital with serious but stable injuries (BCSO case 24-02937)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Colorado Hoist Rescue Team, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Nederland Fire Protection District, MedEvac, American Medical Response
notes: run-772 merge: NFPD board report (Skywalker Couloir skier item matches row details exactly);
